run_voc_actions_handler: run the voc_actions_handler function to process a PASCAL VOC 2012 actions dataset from a tar archive path
create_actions_to_ids: create a function that converts action label dictionaries to numeric ID lists using a label_to_id mapping
extract_image_fnames_for_subset: extract image filenames for a given subset and action list from a tarfile archive
review_voc_actions_dataset: review the voc_actions_dataset DownloadableDataset definition with download URLs and handler configuration
summarize_make_gen: summarize the make_gen generator that yields cropped object images with multi-label action annotations from VOC XML
